## History

Mrs. Spencer was responsible for the mix-up that brought [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the boy [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) had requested. ## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is the child of Spencer. During [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Anne's visit to resolve the orphan adoption mix-up, [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is present in the Spencer home. Her parent manages the domestic arrangements and interactions with visitors like [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md).

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
